gloss: daycare child; preschooler at a nursery school

definitions.gloss: daycare child; a child enrolled at a nursery school / daycare center
definitions.explanation: A child between roughly 0 and 6 years old who attends a {保育園|ほいくえん} — a Japanese daycare center that cares for infants and preschool-age children while parents work. Distinguished from kindergarten-goers, who are called {幼稚園児|ようちえんじ}.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}は{保育園児|ほいくえんじ}だ。
examples.english: My son is a daycare child.

examples.japanese: {保育園児|ほいくえんじ}たちが{公園|こうえん}で{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: Some daycare kids are playing in the park.

examples.japanese: {保育園児|ほいくえんじ}の{娘|むすめ}は、{毎朝|まいあさ}{泣|な}かずに{登園|とうえん}できるようになった。
examples.english: My daycare-aged daughter has gotten to the point where she can go to daycare each morning without crying.

notes:
Compound of {保育園|ほいくえん} (daycare, nursery) and {〜児|じ} (child). The paired term {幼稚園児|ようちえんじ} refers to kindergarten children; the distinction matters in Japan because the two systems fall under different ministries and serve somewhat different age ranges and family needs. In casual speech parents often shorten this to just {園児|えんじ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保育園児|ほいくえんじ}の{送|おく}り{迎|むか}え: dropping off and picking up daycare kids
- {保育園児|ほいくえんじ}{向|む}けの{絵本|えほん}: picture books for daycare-age kids
- {保育園児|ほいくえんじ}の{生活|せいかつ}: daily life of a daycare child
- {保育園児|ほいくえんじ}を{持|も}つ{親|おや}: parents who have a child in daycare
- {保育園児|ほいくえんじ}の{頃|ころ}: when (someone) was in daycare

RELATED WORDS:
- {保育園|ほいくえん}: daycare center — the facility
- {幼稚園児|ようちえんじ}: kindergartener — peer term for children at {幼稚園|ようちえん}
- {園児|えんじ}: preschooler — umbrella term covering both daycare and kindergarten kids
- {保育士|ほいくし}: licensed childcare worker — the adult staff at daycare

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese daycare ({保育園|ほいくえん}) is primarily childcare for working parents and accepts children from as young as a few months old. Kindergarten ({幼稚園|ようちえん}) is more of an educational program for ages 3-5. Families often choose based on whether parents work and what hours they need coverage.
